item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Oct 26
item.description:
The Monday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 26, 2026: conditions around Londonderry through tomorrow morning; Justice Department charges against forty-eight noncitizens over illegal voting, a preliminary twenty-five percent drop in violent victimization, and the last week on the campaign trail; talks under way in Tehran, arrests in Jordan's church attack and a Russian drone strike in Vinnytsia; markets lifted by Anthropic's filing and Meta's ninety-five-billion-dollar raise as Brazil's stocks plunge, plus Verizon earnings; a new OLED iPad mini, easyJet picks Starlink and TSMC's Phoenix plant; Anthropic's public IPO filing; a startup's twelve-hour break-in at Anthropic; your X feed; a poisoned bald eagle in Brookline and Londonderry's legal bills; and an island that turns off its lights for seabirds. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday Morning, Oct 26
item.description:
The Monday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for October 26, 2026: nearly twenty-nine million early votes with eight days to go, appeals judges sound skeptical of the Justice Department's California ballot suit, New Mexico's flood cleanup and Trump's record-long post about Bill Maher; Lula wins a fourth term in Brazil as Flávio Bolsonaro seeks annulment, Vučić concedes in Serbia, Gulf neighbors in Tehran as U.S. forces stand ready, Saudi-led strikes on Sanaa and China's plenum; an in-depth markets look ahead of the Fed and Big Tech earnings; self-driving approvals in China; Anthropic's possible IPO filing and Claude's Georgia paywall incident; the Gheist GitHub campaign and a PHP2Shell correction; your X feed; New Hampshire's school tax-cap question and Halloween week around Londonderry; and fifty-three orangutans rescued from Borneo's fires. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
